_comment: Known-schema registry for secretsmith. search --schema NAME resolves here; unregistered raw xdg:schema strings still work but warn. This registry is what makes the original wrong-schema empty search impossible: default search has no schema filter, and --schema validates against these names.

chromium.description: Chromium/Chrome os_crypt key on Linux Secret Service. The item secret IS the AES key (often base64).

generic.description: Generic libsecret items (NOT what Chromium uses — searching this schema for browser keys returns empty).
